notes: Package: @beep/repo-cli at packages/tooling/tool/cli. Runner: vitest via `beep:test` = `bunx --bun vitest run` (i.e. vitest under Bun); vitest.config.ts merges root ../../../../vitest.shared.ts with: exclude test/fixtures/**, fileParallelism:false, sequence.concurrent:false, testTimeout 30_000, globalSetup test/global-cleanup.ts — tests are strictly sequential, so ordering/temp-dir assumptions may exist (test/support/CommandTest.ts does process.chdir into temp dirs with finalizer restore). Type tests: `type-test` script = `cd ../../../.. && bunx tstyche`; single type-test file dtslint/Files.tst.ts using tstyche describe/expect. IMPORT STYLE (refactor safety): all package-source imports in test/ use @beep/* aliases per repo law — three flavors: (1) root barrel `@beep/repo-cli` (filesCommand, imageCommand, lintCommand), (2) subpath barrels `@beep/repo-cli/commands/<Group>` defined in package.json exports, (3) test-kit alias `@beep/repo-cli/test/<Group>` mapping (exports field) to src/test/<Group>.test-kit.ts, which re-export command internals — including internal/* files that are otherwise export-blocked (exports set `./internal/*`: null, `./commands/{Quality,Research,Yeet}/internal/*`: null). Two deep internal alias imports bypass kits: @beep/repo-cli/commands/AgentEffectiveness/internal/EvalScorer and @beep/repo-cli/commands/Quality/FallowQuality.command. Yeet/Quality test-kits use RELATIVE ../commands/**/internal/*.js re-exports, so renames of Closeout/Handler/PacketRenderer/CoverageRegression must update the kits. Only relative import inside test/ is local helper ./support/CommandTest.js (permitted). test/tsconfig.json extends ../tsconfig.json, includes **/*.test.ts + ../madge.d.ts, excludes fixtures. Non-command tests: foundation-topology.test.ts and schema-topology/jsdoc-categories partly test repo-wide invariants / @beep/repo-utils, not CLI groups (foundation-topology uses Bun globals — must run under Bun). Zero-coverage groups: Codegen, Codex, Docs, Fallow, Reuse, Root.ts, TopoSort. Git status: schema-first.test.ts and several src command files (AIMetrics, AgentEffectiveness, Corpus.recyclebin) are locally modified on branch deps-update-7-7-26.
